# uptimekuma_notification_onesender (Resource)

OneSender notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_onesender" "private" {
  name          = "OneSender Private"
  url           = "https://onesender.example.com/api/v1/send"
  token         = "your-api-token"
  receiver      = "+6281234567890"
  type_receiver = "private"
  is_default    = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_onesender" "group" {
  name          = "OneSender Group"
  url           = "https://onesender.example.com/api/v1/send"
  token         = "your-api-token"
  receiver      = "group-id-123"
  type_receiver = "group"
  is_default    = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: token_wo is never stored in plan
# or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_onesender" "write_only" {
  name          = "OneSender with write-only secret"
  url           = "https://onesender.example.com/api/v1/send"
  receiver      = "+6281234567890"
  type_receiver = "private"

  token_wo         = "your-api-token"
  token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `receiver` (String) Recipient identifier (phone number or group ID)
- `type_receiver` (String) Type of receiver: `private` for individual or `group` for group
- `url` (String, Sensitive) OneSender API endpoint URL for sending messages

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token for authentication with OneSender service. Stored in state; use `token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API token for authentication with OneSender service, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `token`; requires `token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `token` until the next apply with `token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `token_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
